title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Strategic priority, Why Change, Why Now, Why Glean, PBO, supporting source/date, evidence class, unknown, validation owner

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Hypothesis: approved support guidance may reduce repeated search; outcome and baseline remain to be confirmed.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Customer confirms priority and relevant workflow; hypotheses remain labeled.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Prerequisite, evidence/link, status, gap, owner, due, go/narrow/reschedule decision, rationale

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Sponsor path not confirmed → AE to arrange alignment → narrow to qualification rather than full workshop.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: No false completed gates; missing readiness has an explicit action.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Purpose, expected outputs, attendees/roles, agenda, requested workflows/KPIs/tools, pre-work deadline, access/recording arrangements

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Please share goals, two recurring workflows, current systems and pain two days before the session; we will leave with priorities and next interviews.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Customer-facing only; no internal benchmarks or restricted research.
